BUILD HENDERSONVILLE NEW PARTICIPATORY BUDGET PROGRAM IN THE CITY OF HENDERSONVILLE
item.description: – The City of Hendersonville is making its budget process moreinteractive than ever with the launch of a new participatory budgeting program called BuildHendersonville. The City is setting aside $25,000 for residents to decide how the funds should be used to improve thecommunity. item.title: WINTER STORM WATCH ISSUED FOR BUNCOMBE AND HENDERSON COUNTIES STARTING FRIDAY AFTERNOON
item.description: As another winter storm moves into the western North Carolina region, Buncombe County and Henderson County will be under a winter storm watch beginning at 4 p.m. on Friday, Jan. 29. The winter storm watch will remain in effect through Saturday night. According to a release from Buncombe County, the county says, unlike the ice storm last week, no significant impacts to power are expected.
